mapper.sql: BIN_TO_UUID(id) AS id, username, username_normalized, password_hash, role, status, password_change_required, failed_login_count, last_failed_login_at, locked_until, session_version, created_at, updated_at, row_version
mapper.select: SELECT FROM user_account WHERE username_normalized = #{usernameNormalized} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM user_account WHERE id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{id})
SELECT FROM user_account WHERE id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{id}) FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_account WHERE role = 'ADMIN'
SELECT FROM user_account ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_account ( id, username, username_normalized, password_hash, role, status, password_change_required, failed_login_count, session_version, created_at, updated_at, row_version ) VALUES ( UUID_TO_BIN(#{id}), #{username}, #{usernameNormalized}, #{passwordHash}, #{role}, #{status}, #{passwordChangeRequired}, #{failedLoginCount}, #{sessionVersion}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{rowVersion} )
mapper.update: UPDATE user_account SET locked_until = CASE WHEN failed_login_count + 1 >= 5 THEN #{lockedUntil} ELSE locked_until END, failed_login_count = LEAST(failed_login_count + 1, 1000), last_failed_login_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{id})
UPDATE user_account SET failed_login_count = 0, last_failed_login_at = NULL, locked_until = NULL, updated_at = #{now}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{id})

UPDATE user_account SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, password_change_required = #{passwordChangeRequired}, session_version = session_version + 1, failed_login_count = 0, last_failed_login_at = NULL, locked_until = NULL, updated_at = #{now}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{id}) AND row_version = #{expectedRowVersion}

UPDATE user_account SET status = #{status}, session_version = session_version + 1, updated_at = #{now}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{id}) AND role = 'USER' AND row_version = #{expectedRowVersion}
